entry_defaults.fallback: Disable the LiveView renderer adapter; portable core, host protocol, and standalone DOM remain usable.

entries.shape: new_components/0-1, new_fingerprints/0, render/4, render_private/2, write_component/4, update_component/3, mark_for_deletion_component/2, delete_component/2
entries.upgrade_trigger: Any Phoenix LiveView version, diff tuple, component state, or wire-key change
entries.risk: LocalLiveView directly owns LiveView's private diff state and deletion/update protocol.

entries.upgrade_trigger: Renderer macro, rendered structure, template metadata, or callback change
entries.risk: Compilation and first render depend on internals rather than a supported extension point.

entries.shape: clear_changed/1, clear_temp/1, changed?/1-2, post_mount_prune/1, normalize_layout/1, clear_flash/1-2, put_reply/2, maybe_call_live_view_mount!/4-5
entries.upgrade_trigger: Socket assignment bookkeeping, mount, flash, reply, layout, or temporary-state change
entries.risk: The adapter reproduces LiveView process state transitions through private helpers.

entries.visibility: private module; build/1 is explicitly doc false
entries.upgrade_trigger: Lifecycle stage, hook state, callback arity, or return-shape change
entries.risk: Local mount and event stages shadow the server LiveView lifecycle.

entries.shape: Session struct fields enumerated by the compatibility fixture
entries.upgrade_trigger: Session field, verification, root/parent, router, flash, or assign_new change
entries.risk: The dispatcher manually constructs a private session with only a view field.

entries.visibility: public struct with internal state fields and private invariants
entries.shape: Socket fields enumerated by the compatibility fixture; direct writes include id, view, private, assigns, host_uri, redirected
entries.upgrade_trigger: Struct fields, default private/assign state, redirect tuple, URI, or transport semantics change
entries.risk: A stable struct name does not make direct reconstruction of LiveView process state public API.

entries.source: phoenix_live_view 1.2.11 server diff encoder and priv/static/phoenix_live_view.esm.js
entries.shape: Rendered diff maps, component ids, events, replies, redirects, titles, streams, and component pruning consumed by the stock LiveView client
entries.call_site: local_live_view 0.1.0 server.ex plus browser channel-shaped transport bridge
entries.upgrade_trigger: Any server/client LiveView pair, diff key, DOM patch, stream, navigation, or upload protocol change
entries.risk: The local bridge must keep exact server and browser LiveView implementations paired.

entries.shape: Actions enumerated by the compatibility fixture with promise resolve/reject and per-view process routing
entries.call_site: LocalLiveView dispatcher and browser JavaScript bridge
entries.upgrade_trigger: LocalLiveView, Popcorn message, promise, iframe, worker, or action payload change
entries.risk: This is not a standardized Wasm component interface and must not leak into portable BlazeX packages.

conditions: The exact Phoenix LiveView and LocalLiveView pair is pinned.
The fixture and a behavior probe gate every dependency update.
Portable/runtime packages never parse LiveView diff or session data.
Failure disables the adapter instead of weakening portable boundaries.
confinement_decision.stop_condition: Stop if any private structure must enter blazex_core, blazex_ui, blazex_effects, blazex_renderer_dom, runtime protocol, or a host-neutral package.
